contracts.autoloads: NONE new in CORE. PlayerRoster and MultiplayerSession are children of WorldRoot2D.

hotbar slot chords documented in MP2 (shoulder + d-pad)
contracts.lookupRule: NEVER get_first_node_in_group('player') / is_in_group('player') for identity. Use WorldRoot2D.player_by_id / local_player / player_for_event. A lint (MP1) fails the suite on new occurrences.
contracts.authority: Host-authoritative. Guests send intent; host validates and applies; results replicate. Guests never write world state or the save.

decisions.title: LAN, one machine per player, up to 4
decisions.decision: ENetMultiplayerPeer over the local network. Host creates a session, up to three guests join by IP/host code in CORE. No split-screen, no internet matchmaking in this track.
decisions.why: User decision 2026-10-18. Split-screen is a different (harder) problem: shared viewport, four cameras, four device maps.

decisions.title: Shared farm + world, separate inventories
decisions.decision: One farm, one calendar, shared shop stock/animals/buildings/loot/world flags. Each player has own gold, backpack, equipment, hotbar, quests, wardrobe, vitals. Home tier, home chest and furniture are household-shared.
decisions.why: User decision 2026-10-18; matches Stardew default and the existing 'one world, one farm' design.

decisions.title: Host owns the save
decisions.decision: One host-side JSON payload holds the world and up to four player profiles (payload v3). Guests do not persist the world. Host disconnect ends the session.
decisions.why: User decision 2026-10-18; only coherent with host-authoritative simulation.

decisions.title: Host-authoritative simulation
decisions.decision: The host runs farm, time, shops, enemies, loot and quest application. Guests send intent (use_tool, interact, buy, accept_quest); the host re-validates and applies, then replicates results.
decisions.why: Cheapest correct model for a farm game; makes the host save the world of record; kills double-spend races at the source.

decisions.title: EventBus gains a player_id on player-scoped signals
decisions.decision: Wave 2 is one contract cut: ~21 signals gain player_id as first argument; 4 new signals. World-scoped signals keep arity. The arity lint and every consumer land together.
decisions.why: The bus is the sole cross-system hub and is arity-linted; a half-migrated bus cannot ship.

decisions.title: No new autoload
decisions.decision: PlayerRoster and MultiplayerSession are children of WorldRoot2D, not autoloads. Session lifetime is world lifetime; tests can spawn a world without a global session.
decisions.why: Autoload order is already a 16-node contract; multiplayer must not extend it.

decisions.title: SocialManager friendship rows become per-player
decisions.decision: SocialManager._rows is keyed by player_id -> npc_id. Shared campaign state (world_seed, festivals, household partner) stays global. World flag mirrors friend_<npc> become player-scoped mirrors under flags or move into the players row (RM8 decides the exact shape).
decisions.why: The one real conflict with TOWNS_FARM_SOCIAL_ADDENDUM.md. Hearts are per-hero in every social RPG; the household still shares the house and festivals.

decisions.title: is_single_player becomes live
decisions.decision: GameManager.is_single_player is true when players.size() == 1 and no peer is connected. Pause, sleep and save paths read it. The unused variable becomes a real gate.
decisions.why: The only multiplayer-shaped hook in the codebase; it should stop being dead weight.

decisions.title: Single-player parity is a wave gate
decisions.decision: Every wave keeps tests/run_playtest.sh --strict green for all four characters with players[0] behaviour identical to today's one player.
decisions.why: Multiplayer is a later scope; it must not regress the shipped single-player game.

decisions.title: Sleep is a vote with host force
decisions.decision: The day ends when every living player is in bed. The host pause menu may force sleep. Config key multiplayer.sleep_requires_all (default true).
decisions.why: Stardew-like expectation; one clock means one day roll.

risks.risk: EventBus arity change touches ~21 signals and every consumer
risks.mitigation: One wave (wave 2), arity lint is the net, MP3 owns the whole cut
MP1 replaces them all; lint no_first_player_group fails the suite on new occurrences
Host-authoritative + intent validation; world mutations only on host; periodic farm hash in net tests (MP5)

risks.risk: Save migration breaks existing player saves
risks.mitigation: v2->v3 migration is test-pinned in tests/sections/save.gd; v2 files still load as players[0]

risks.risk: Input abstraction regresses feel (tool repeat, dodge, aim)
risks.mitigation: MP2 ships a single-player parity section; --strict playtest is the gate

risks.risk: GL Compatibility + ENet on weak Wi-Fi
risks.mitigation: LAN only; unreliable channel for transforms with interpolation on guests; no public-internet claims

risks.risk: Feature managers still write 'the' player via GameData.eco()
risks.mitigation: MP3 introduces a PlayerState boundary object; managers take an explicit player handle

Sleep: all-in-bed vote or host forces?
When the host quits mid-day, do guests get a copy of the save?
openQuestions.default: no; session ends; host save is the world of record

openQuestions.question: Can a guest resume their profile on another host later?
openQuestions.default: no in this track; profile lives with the host save

openQuestions.question: Design Children / hero-twin rules for multiplayer now?
LAN discovery in CORE or EXTENDED?
openQuestions.default: EXTENDED (MP8); CORE is join-by-IP / host code
